review_candidates.title: Group Head of Finance
review_candidates.description: Group Head of Finance (Copenhagen based) Location: This is an office-based role at group headquarters in central Copenhagen (some travel required), working alongside the founders & management team. Who We Are: Nordic Group is an independent, family-led healthcare group headquartered in Copenhagen. It was founded in 1997 with Nordic Laboratories, the first to offer a microbiome test to the European market. Today the group comprises more than ten companies & 150 people, with staff in 20 markets, 15,000+ practitioners supplied & 1 million+ customers served. Its purpose is to move healthcare from reactive treatment to prevention & personalised medicine. The group has two parts: The operating companies . Nordic Laboratories (Copenhagen, with a wholly owned laboratory in Finland) selects & audits partner laboratories worldwide & supplies functional & genetic testing to practitioners in 100+ countries. Nordic Clinic practises functional medicine across its clinics. Nordic Health is the group's practitioner-focused supplement division, active in 50+ countries. DNALife is its nutrigenomic & pharmacogenomic testing brand. Investments: Since 2018, the group has taken stakes in Resistomap (Helsinki, antibiotic resistance monitoring), Functional Future (Copenhagen, organic supplements), Dsruptive Subdermals (Stockholm, implantable NFC health technology), ThermoCheck (London, breast thermography), Innovative Pet Lab (Georgia, USA, pet diagnostics) & BeUNO Pet (Almería, Spain, pet biometric monitoring). What Is Happening Next: The group expects 25% growth this year, supported by targeted acquisitions, the accelerated expansion of Nordic Laboratories & the compounding performance of its subsidiaries. It is entering new regions while deepening distribution in established ones. Why This Role Exists: Finance today runs on a capable bookkeeping team in Copenhagen & Stockholm using Uniconta, with consolidated accounts prepared in Excel. Ten companies across eight jurisdictions, with acquisitions on the agenda, need more than that. We want a consolidation tool for the group accounts & AI embedded across the whole finance function, from bookkeeping & the close to reporting, forecasting, tax & compliance, so that manual work is automated & the team's time goes into the expansion & deeper analysis rather than into the process. There is no Group CFO today. Group finance leadership sits with the Chief of Staff alongside a wider executive mandate. The Group Head of Finance will: Take the group from entity-level bookkeeping to consolidated, audit-ready group financials, produced monthly to a standard the founders can rely on. Build the reporting that shows which companies earn their capital, & the forecast that anticipates cash rather than reports it. Own tax & compliance across every jurisdiction where the group has an entity, so that nothing lapses & nothing surprises. Establish the controls, systems, & processes that allow a family-led group to make acquisitions safely. Act as finance counterpart to every company CEO in the portfolio, & as the founders' first call when a decision needs a number behind it. Grow into the Group CFO position. The mandate expands as it is earned, & for the right person the title follows within two to three years. How This Role Is Resourced: You inherit the Copenhagen & Stockholm finance teams, including a Senior Bookkeeper now being recruited; auditors & local advisers are in place across the jurisdictions. You report to the Chief of Staff & work directly with the founders & management team.  What You Will Own: 1. Group Reporting & Consolidation (primary) The month-end close across every entity & consolidation into group financials: intercompany eliminations, foreign currency, minority interests, & portfolio investments. The monthly mgt pack for founders & company boards: one version of the truth, on time, every month. The annual stat accounts & audits in each jurisdiction, & the relationship with the auditors. Group accounting policies & the chart of accounts, so that ten companies report in one language. An internal control review of every entity twice a year. 2. Planning, Budgeting & Performance Annual budget & the rolling forecast at entity & group level. Unit-level profit & loss by company & product line: testing, clinics, supplements, genetics, & portfolio. The KPI framework for businesses with different economics: laboratory testing, clinics, supplements & technology investments. Better margins. Work with the CEO, the Chief Commercial Officer & suppliers to sharpen the strategy around specific products, negotiate better pricing, & track the effect on gross margin. Challenge on spending & headcount decisions, supported by evidence. 3. Cash, Treasury & Working Capital Rolling 13-week & 12-month cash forecasts at entity & group level, & group liquidity. Banking relationships across the jurisdictions, foreign currency exposure & intercompany funding. Working capital: partner laboratory payables, practitioner & clinic receivables, supplement inventory, & the cash absorbed by growth. 4. Tax & Compliance Across Borders VAT across the group, including cross-border supplies, OSS & Union Scheme reporting, split VAT & Lønsumsafgift for both clinics & laboratories, executed by the bookkeeping team. Corporate tax compliance in each jurisdiction with local advisers, & the transfer pricing policy & documentation for intercompany services: laboratory testing, the VMS platform, supplements & management services. The corporate calendar across every entity: filings, licences, renewals & deadlines. Engagement, management & cost of external advisers. 5. Controls, Systems & Process The internal control framework: approvals, cut-off, segregation of duties & audit-ready records in every entity. Automation across the function, applying AI & automation tools to bookkeeping, the close, reporting, forecasting, tax & compliance. 6. Acquisitions, Investments & Portfolio Reporting Financial due diligence on targeted acquisitions, & integration from completion: opening balance sheets, controls, reporting & people. Reporting on the portfolio investments: performance, valuation, impairment, funding needs & where capital earns its return. Support to the Portfolio Director & the founders on structure, funding & exits across the portfolio. 7. Team, Founders & the CFO Path Leadership of the Copenhagen & Stockholm finance teams: hiring, development & the standard of their work. The finance relationship with every company CEO across the group, from a laboratory in Helsinki to a pet diagnostics business in Georgia. Work with the Chief of Staff & the management team on group structure, funding & strategy, taking on the Group CFO agenda as it is earned. What You Must Bring: Required Fluency in English, & 10+ years in finance, including at least 3 years in a commercial, operating business in a similar role (Finance Manager, Financial Controller or Head of Finance). A professional accounting qualification (statsautoriseret revisor, ACA, ACCA, CA, CPA or equivalent). Multi-entity, multi-currency group experience with consolidation: intercompany, foreign currency & minority interests. Fluency in IFRS & a working understanding of Danish GAAP; statutory reporting in the other jurisdictions is handled with local advisers. Comfort with different tax systems: VAT, corporate tax & transfer pricing applied well in more than one jurisdiction, evidenced through references. Cash discipline: ownership of a rolling cash forecast & a working capital agenda in a business with inventory, receivables & growth. Experience of leading a team & raising its standard. A great communicator. Demonstrable use of AI & automation tools in your own finance work. The ambition to be a Group CFO within two to three years. Preferred Big 4 training in audit or advisory, followed by the commercial experience above. Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, life sciences, consumer health or a product business with inventory & international distribution. Danish is preferable but not a must. Uniconta or another mid-market ERP & consolidation experience. Experience in a founder-led business, where decisions are fast & data-led. This Is Not the Role for You If: Your career has been entirely in practice. You have only run a single entity, or a division of a large corporate. You are not comfortable working across different jurisdictions. You need a fully built team, a mature ERP & a written process before you can add value. You prefer to review rather than do. You are not using AI tools in your work today. You do not want the Group CFO position, or you expect it from day one. Personality & Cultural Fit: Direct, composed, & a strong communicator. Equally credible with a founder, a laboratory director in Helsinki & a bookkeeper in Copenhagen. A builder. You would rather fix a process than describe its faults. High standards for reporting, in your team & in yourself. A mentor for your team. Interested in what the group does.  What We Offer: A competitive base salary, depending on experience. A defined path to Group CFO. The mandate expands as you earn it. Direct access to the founders & a seat at the leadership table from day one. A purpose worth standing behind: prevention & personalised medicine. Ten companies to learn from, with time spent with them internationally. Discounts on functional medicine tests & supplements, & a sociable team with regular events. If you want a quieter version of the job you already have, this is not it. If you have run finance in a growing business, know what a group finance function should look like & have not yet had the mandate to build one, we would like to hear from you. How to Apply: Please apply via LinkedIn. Questions to Sami Malia, sami@nordicgroup.eu. We intend to make an appointment as soon as possible.
